newsitem.title: USA: RTRS-S&P says affirms News Corp.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P says affirms News Corp.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said it has affirmed its triple-B' rating on News Corp Ltd and placed the ratings of EchoStar Communications Corp and related entities on credit watch with positive implications.
EchoStar ratings, which may be raised or affirmed, are as follows:
-- EchoStar Communications' single-B' issuer credit rating,
-- Dish Ltd.'s single-B' corporate credit and senior secured debt rating, and
-- EchoStar Satellite Broadcasting Corp.'s single-B'-minus senior secured debt and single-B' issuer credit ratings.

S&P said the CreditWatch positive listing reflects the recent agreement by News Corp to contribute cash, satellites, and other assets with a total consideration of US$1 billion in exchange for 50 percent of EchoStar's equity.

"This injection of much-needed capital into the fledgling EchoStar direct to home (DTH) multichannel TV service will bolster the firm's ability to compete in this still-developing industry," S&P said.
"Moreover, the addition of News Corp.'s satellite transponder space gives the firm the potential to vastly expand its channel offerings," it said.

Since News Corp was expected to launch its own DTH service over the next two years, the combination of the two firms' satellite TV efforts reduces the expected level of competition in the marketplace, the ratings agency said.
S&P said it would review the transaction and the firm's business plans to evaluate the ratings impact.
